NAME:
   rancher skill - Install, remove and check the agent skills that come with rancher-cli

USAGE:
   rancher skill [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   install:    Install the rancher-cli agent skill into coding-agent harnesses
   status:     Report, for each harness, the installed skill version and whether its files are unchanged
   uninstall:  Remove the agent skills that rancher-cli installed

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
